definition.name: one-dimensional-projection-nonvanishing
definition.definition: Byte-matched from refs/kitaev-2405.02434/approximate_algebras.tex (tex:1066): When P=Q, the abbreviations Co_P, S_P are used. It is clear that S_P=0 if and only if P is sufficiently close to 0 as described by the first alternative in P_alternatives. (Recall that in the opposite case, we call P nonvanishing.) Similarly, Co_P=1 and S_P=A if and only if P is close to I. If dim S_P=1, we say that P is a one-dimensional delta-projection. (Available consequence: dim S_P=1 implies S_P != 0, hence the second P_alternatives alternative holds — a one-dimensional delta-projection is nonvanishing.)
